shots.text: Gorrath had been a Stoneborn general, the man who held the Kharum Pass for a month. He went to the Rift two years ago, like the Saltmother. He came back with his heart cut out and a carved stone in its place.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Gorrath breaking apart on the ridge into boulders that keep rolling, then stop. The carved stone heart in his chest cracks.

shots.text: Out of the dust rode Kaela Stormrider, the Galeborn's war-leader. She had been fighting his army alone for eleven days, falling back from camp to camp.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Kaela Stormrider bursting out of the dust on her grey stallion Thunderclap, lightning lance crackling, white war-paint across her face.

shots.text: Eleven days I've been riding away from that thing. I hate riding away. Point me at the next one.
shots.speaker: kaela
shots.art_note: Kaela reining in beside the player's towers, looking back at Highwind. Joins as a hero.
